dmn_experiences.title: Beer Tours of Lewes
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided beer tour of Lewes led by an Advanced Cicerone, taking in Harvey's Brewery and the town's craft breweries for tastings.
highlights: Led by an Advanced Cicerone and international beer judge
Visits Harvey's Brewery and the John Harvey pub
Tastings at craft breweries Beak and Abyss
Hand-picked beers at each stop
Easy walking tour through historic Lewes

dmn_experiences.title: Guided Brighton Beer Tour & Tasting
dmn_experiences.summary: An expert-led walking tour of four Brighton beer venues, finishing at the Unbarred taproom, hosted by an Advanced Cicerone.
highlights: Visits The Brick, The Rook, The Evening Star and the Unbarred taproom
Led by an Advanced Cicerone and international beer judge
Insights and facts about each beer and venue
Just over a mile of walking
Over-18s only

dmn_experiences.title: Brewery Tour
dmn_experiences.summary: A tour of UnBarred Brewery in central Brighton covering the brewing process from grain to glass, followed by a tasting of six beers.
highlights: Guided tour of the on-site brewing process
Tasting of six craft beers from cask ale to New England IPAs
Reserved taproom table and branded glass included
Ten minutes' walk from Brighton Station
Over-18s only

dmn_experiences.title: Brewery Tour & Guided Tasting
dmn_experiences.summary: A brewery tour and guided tasting at North Laine Brewhouse covering the brewing process and the on-site Laine Brew Co beers.
highlights: Behind-the-scenes tour of the Laine Brew Co microbrewery
Talk on beer history and brewing methods
Guided tasting of award-winning beers
Complimentary drink tokens included
Central Brighton location
